info.name: TeamsLogic
info.summary: Google and Microsoft 365 calendars, contacts and mail in Nextcloud
info.description: TeamsLogic for Nextcloud is the server side of the TeamsLogic desktop app. Each user connects their Google or Microsoft 365 account once: their calendars and address books sync both ways with Nextcloud (every few minutes, or on demand), and the same sign-in sets up the account in Nextcloud Mail.
info.author: Aegean Logic
